page.content:
Wukong's birthplace and monkey kingdom.

How Flower–Fruit Mountain connects

  • Character: Sun Wukong — Wukong is born and first crowned on Flower–Fruit Mountain.
  • Location: Water-Curtain Cave — Water-Curtain Cave is the hidden palace of the mountain.

What is Flower–Fruit Mountain?

Flower–Fruit Mountain is the blessed island where the stone monkey is born, claims the Water-Curtain Cave, and first styles himself king before the revolt against Heaven.

Key threads lead to Sun Wukong and Water-Curtain Cave.
